bull_case: MELI integrates commerce, logistics, payments, credit and ads into one digital operating system for Latin America, lowering friction where banking, logistics and online retail remain underpenetrated.
bear_case: The model is powerful but increasingly resembles scale execution rather than new disruption. Banks, Nubank, Amazon, Shopee and local retailers can attack individual layers.
thesis: MELI is a proven disruptive platform even though it is ineligible for Moonshot because market cap exceeds $20B. It has replaced fragmented offline commerce and payment workflows with an integrated marketplace, logistics and fintech stack, and adoption is still accelerating. GMV, TPV and fintech usage show mainstream scale. The remaining question is whether ecosystem economics stay superior as credit and logistics become more capital intensive.

evidence.claim: MELI is the regional e-commerce leader by GMV and Mercado Pago leads fintech MAUs in several core countries.
FY2025 GMV was $65.0B and TPV $277.8B, with fintech MAUs 78M.
Frozen market cap is about $92.53B, above the Moonshot cap.

counterevidence: Individual ecosystem layers face strong local and global competitors.
Credit adds capital intensity and underwriting risk.
Commerce/logistics scale can become operationally complex and margin-dilutive.
At current penetration, some disruption has already been captured.
unknowns: Long-run contribution of ads and credit to ecosystem ROIC.
Competitive share trends versus Nubank, Amazon and Shopee.
Incremental economics in smaller Latin American markets.

uncertainties.rationale: Integrated logistics and payments materially reduce regional friction.
GMV, TPV and MAU scale show mainstream adoption.
Multiple options exist, but well-funded competitors can respond.

falsifiers: Ecosystem cross-sell stops improving customer economics.
GMV/TPV growth converges to market while margins stay depressed.
Competitors disintermediate a major layer without offsetting gains elsewhere.

key_kpis.name: Cross-ecosystem monetization
key_kpis.threshold: Ads, credit and payments deepen without destroying FCF

subscores.rationale: Integrated marketplace, logistics and payments materially lower regional transaction friction.
The platform is at mainstream scale while key volumes still grow rapidly.
Many adjacent monetization paths exist, though competitors can attack individual layers.
